units.source_text: 这晚上两人都有密约，但揶揄了一阵之后，都不去了。

en.t: That evening both men had secret appointments, but after teasing each other for a while, neither of them went.

units.source_text: 他们并不分手，共乘了一辆车子回左大臣邸去。

en.t: They did not part ways, but rode together in one carriage back to the Minister of the Left's residence.

units.source_text: 月亮也解风情，故意躲入云中；两人在车中吹着笛，沿着幽暗的夜路迤逦前进。

en.t: Even the moon seemed to understand the mood and deliberately hid behind the clouds; the two men played their flutes in the carriage as they slowly made their way along the dim night road.

units.source_text: 到了家门，叫前驱者不要作声，悄悄地走进屋里。

en.t: When they reached the gate, they told the attendants going ahead not to make a sound and quietly entered the house.

units.source_text: 在没有人的廊下脱下便衣，换上常礼服，装作刚从宫中退出的样子，拿出箫笛来吹奏。

en.t: In an empty corridor they took off their casual clothes, changed into formal court robes, pretended they had just withdrawn from the palace, and brought out their flutes to play.

units.source_text: 左大臣照例不肯放过此种机会，拿了一支高丽笛来和他们合奏。

en.t: As usual, the Minister of the Left would not let such an opportunity pass, so he took up a Korean flute and joined them in ensemble.

units.source_text: 他擅长此道，吹得非常动听。

en.t: He was skilled in this art, and his playing was extremely pleasing to hear.

units.source_text: 葵姬也在帘内命侍女取出琴来，叫会弹的人操奏。

en.t: Lady Aoi, from behind the curtain, also ordered her attendants to bring out a koto and had someone who could play it perform.

units.source_text: 其中有一个侍女叫作中务君的，善弹琵琶。

en.t: Among them was an attendant called Nakatsukasa no Kimi, who was skilled at playing the biwa.

units.source_text: 头中将曾经看中她，但她不理睬，却对于这个难得见面的源氏公子始终不能忘情。

en.t: The Captain had once taken an interest in her, but she paid him no attention; instead, she could never forget Lord Genji, whom she so rarely had the chance to see.

units.source_text: 两人的关系自然不能隐瞒，左大臣夫人听到了很不高兴。

en.t: Naturally, the relationship between the two could not be kept hidden, and when the Minister of the Left's wife heard about it, she was very displeased.

units.source_text: 因此这时候中务君闷闷不乐，不便上前，没精打采地靠在角落里。

en.t: For that reason, Nakatsukasa no Kimi was gloomy at this moment, unable to come forward, and leaned listlessly in a corner.

units.source_text: 然而离开很远，全然看不到源氏公子，她又觉得寂寞无聊，心中烦恼。

en.t: Yet because she was far away and could not see Lord Genji at all, she again felt lonely and bored, troubled at heart.
